act_title: THE CHITTAGONG HILL-TRACTS EMPLOYMENT (RECORD OF SERVICES) REGULATION, 1959

sections.section_content: 1. (1) This Regulation may be calledTHE CHITTAGONG HILL-TRACTS EMPLOYMENT (RECORD OF SERVICES) REGULATION, 1959.(2) It shall come into force at once.

2. The Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951 (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), and the rules made thereunder shall, subject to the following amendments apply to the Chittagong Hill-tracts, namely:-AmendmentsAmendment of section 1 of Act No. XIX of 1952Sub-section (2) and (4) of section 1 of the said Act shall beomitted.

footnotes.footnote_text: 1The  word "Government"  was replaced, for the words "Governor of East Pakistan" by  Article 9 of theBangladesh (Adaptation of Existing Laws) Order, 1972(President's Order No. 48 of 1972).
